high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by Sabrina Carpenter. The post features three individuals standing together outdoors at night. People: On the left is a woman with long blonde hair, wearing a black leather jacket. She has a cheerful expression, smiling widely. In the middle is a man wearing sunglasses, a black jacket, and a gold chain necklace. He is holding a cigar in his hand and appears to be looking at the woman on the left. On the right is another man wearing a dark jacket with red accents and a white shirt underneath. He is also looking towards the woman
